title: Happy koala
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#c3d1e0'/>
  <!-- ears outer -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='14' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='30' r='14' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <!-- ears inner -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='8' fill='#e7b7c4'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='30' r='8' fill='#e7b7c4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#a8bccf'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#c3d1e0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#33414f'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#33414f'/>

  <circle cx='60.5' cy='36.5' r='1.6' fill='#eaf2fb'/>

  <path d='M42 56 Q50 63 58 56' stroke='#5a6e82' stroke-width='2.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='70' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='70' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M68 88 Q80 82 84 92 Q76 96 68 88 Z' fill='#6fd08a'/>
  <path d='M68 88 Q76 90 84 92' stroke='#3f9e5e' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='90' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#7d93a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='90' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#7d93a8'/>
</svg>
